english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for firmly maintaining a claim or refusing to give up a demand.
Use this when urging something means insisting on a position, argument, or requirement.

examples.english: I insist I never said that.
examples.traditional: 我堅持自己冇講過嗰句嘢。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gin1 ci4 zi6 gei2 mou5 gong2 gwo3 go2 geoi3 je5

examples.english: The committee urge us to retain this requirement.
examples.traditional: 委員會堅持要我哋保留呢項規定。
examples.jyutping: wai2 jyun4 wui6 gin1 ci4 jiu3 ngo5 dei6 bou2 lau4 ni1 hong6 kwai1 ding6
